title: Coherent evaluation of structural raw scalar relations
statement: Let f:X→S be any scheme morphism, U→S etale and a∈Γ(U,O_U) [def-pc-scheme,def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Transport raw structural classes to coherent unit classes by the inverse explicit coefficient isomorphism [new-unit-structure-coefficient-iso]. If their restricted derived-cohomology images satisfy the local multiplication relation, their coherent Ext evaluations satisfy Sheaf.H.map of smulHom of the pullback of a. The canonical higher-image class of each transported raw class equals the coefficient map applied to its structural class [def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes,lem-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-class-normalization].

proof.text: Define transported raw classes by postcomposition with the inverse unit coefficient map. The coefficient naturality part of rawRestrictedClassNormalization, followed by affineRealizationClass_rawEvaluation, gives the canonical class formula. For evaluation, unfold only affineRealizationRawEquiv, apply sheafHToDerived naturality to the coherent restriction and cancel its Ext equivalence inverse. Raw coefficient naturality identifies the result with derived cohomology of unitLocalizedCoefficientIso. Apply sheafHToDerived injectivity, use localized scalar conjugation and functoriality of derived cohomology, and substitute the given raw equality.
